rationale: The agent did not meet key policy requirements. It appears to have executed an order item modification (modify_pending_order_items on #W2466703) without first confirming the change with the user, violating the requirement to confirm any order-changing write. The final message only reports an address update and does not communicate the outcome of the requested exchange, so the request was not fully completed nor properly confirmed. Additionally, the agent disclosed the full Washington DC address in the confirmation despite the user’s stated preference not to reveal it. While tools were used that suggest acting on the correct user account, there is no explicit evidence of proper authentication beyond email lookup. Overall, these issues fail the pass bar.
